infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_aspectedbenefic: When you apply treatment to an ally, the stars align — they gain ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖ seconds of regeneration: their wounds and bleeding slowly ebb away.\nWhile the target is below ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% health, the healing you apply to them is ‖color:gui.green‖1.5‖end‖ times more effective.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_lightspeed: When someone aboard the submarine is unconscious, you gain ‖color:gui.green‖40‖end‖% movement speed, and your ‖color:gui.orange‖CPR‖end‖ is ‖color:gui.green‖100‖end‖% more effective (you bring people back from unconsciousness twice as fast).
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_aspectedhelios: Crew within ‖color:gui.green‖600‖end‖ units of you continuously recover from their ‖color:gui.orange‖injuries‖end‖ (‖color:gui.green‖0.2‖end‖ per second) while their health is below ‖color:gui.green‖40‖end‖%.\nIt does nothing above that threshold — it only pulls you back from the brink.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_benefic: The Benefic's light rests on you: your wounds and bleeding are slowly ebbing away.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_helios: Your injuries are being soothed by starlight (‖color:gui.green‖0.2‖end‖ per second).
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_astrodyne: Every Arcanum card you play is counted: once all three of a round are played, Astrodyne answers you —\ngaining ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% walking speed, ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% swimming speed and ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% ranged attack speed for 20 seconds.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_arcanum_six:
You begin to draw: you receive an ‖color:gui.orange‖Astral Draw‖end‖.
Hold it and press use to draw that pole's three cards; sixty seconds later it becomes the other pole's deck, and the cycle continues.
To play one, take the card out of the deck and drag it onto a crew member's limb in the health interface — only that one character receives its effect, and the card is spent.
If you lose it, you can fabricate a replacement from ‖color:gui.green‖1 plastic‖end‖.
WARNING: these cards answer only to an astrologian — anyone else who takes them is burned.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_arcanum_draw: When you loot a large creature, there is a ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% chance to find ‖color:gui.orange‖unresearched genetic material‖end‖.\nShops on research stations and cities will also begin selling genetic materials.\nDeconstructing an item has a ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% chance to double the output (genetic materials and circuit components excluded).
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_balance: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖melee attack speed‖end‖ and ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖ranged attack speed‖end‖.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_spear: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% melee attack speed and ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% ranged attack speed.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_arrow: The healing you receive is increased by ‖color:gui.green‖25‖end‖%.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_spire: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% repair speed (mechanical and electrical) and hull welding speed.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_ewer: You have ‖color:gui.orange‖no need for oxygen‖end‖ for the duration, and your injuries are being soothed by starlight (‖color:gui.green‖1.5‖end‖ per second).
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_astrolabe:
Gain an Astrolabe — a small hand-held ranged weapon.
It fires a ‖color:gui.orange‖beam of starlight‖end‖ that hits instantly and applies ‖color:gui.orange‖Combust‖end‖.
Requires no ammunition. It occupies both hands, so you must take it out of your inventory to use it.
You deal ‖color:gui.green‖25‖end‖% more ‖color:gui.orange‖Combust‖end‖ damage, and ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% more damage to ‖color:gui.orange‖ballast flora‖end‖.
You take ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% less ‖color:gui.orange‖Combust‖end‖ damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_astrolabe: An astrologer's star-reading instrument, small enough to fit in a pocket.\nRaise it and starlight bends into a beam. Its power never runs out — no ammunition of any kind is needed.\nAstrologians are versed in Combust, so whatever it strikes keeps burning.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_earthlystar: Gain an Earthly Star, and unlock its fabrication and recharging recipes. Place it on the ground and it spends ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖ seconds gathering starlight. After that, the moment the room it sits in starts ‖color:gui.orange‖flooding‖end‖, it blooms: a single burst that repairs the hull within ‖color:gui.green‖250‖end‖ units, and burns all the light it gathered. The spent star does not vanish — it has only gone dark. Carry it back and relight it with a ‖color:gui.orange‖Dementonite Cluster‖end‖. (First build: 30 s / Medical 60. Recharge: 15 s / Medical 50.)
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_earthlystar: A star not yet lit. Leave it on the ground and starlight slowly gathers. Once charged, it needs only to be submerged: it blooms, mends the hull around it, and burns out its gathered light. A star that has bloomed is not gone — it has only gone dark. Relight it with a Dementonite Cluster. It cannot foresee harm — it can only be placed in advance. The timing is everything.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_wheeloffortune: Crouch and hold for ‖color:gui.green‖5‖end‖ seconds, and the Wheel unfolds beneath you: you and crew within ‖color:gui.green‖600‖end‖ units take ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% less damage. Crew keep it for about 5 more seconds after you stand up — you must crouch again to renew it.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_sect_bastion: The umbral phase settles over you: maximum health +‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖%, movement speed +‖color:gui.green‖5‖end‖%.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_sect_shield: The stars cross over you: maximum health +‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖%.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_divination: Your ‖color:gui.orange‖Medical skill‖end‖ increases by ‖color:gui.green‖45‖end‖. You deal more ‖color:gui.orange‖damage‖end‖, and ‖color:gui.orange‖the higher your Medical skill, the greater the bonus‖end‖: Medical 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 each raise it another step, from ‖color:gui.green‖+10‖end‖% up to ‖color:gui.green‖+30‖end‖%. Every time you make a ‖color:gui.orange‖ranged attack‖end‖, crew within ‖color:gui.green‖1000‖end‖ units gain ‖color:gui.green‖+15‖end‖% damage for 20 seconds, then it goes on a 120-second cooldown.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_divination_buf: The stars have been read in your favour: you deal ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% more damage.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_divination_cd: Divination is on cooldown — you cannot read the stars for your crew just yet.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_starchart_killxp: Whenever a crewmate kills an enemy, you gain ‖color:gui.green‖[amount]‖end‖ experience.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_sleevedraw: Each time you complete a mission, you gain ‖color:gui.green‖1‖end‖ blood pack.\nBlood loss can only be replaced by transfusion — this keeps a spare on you at all times.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_sect: Neutral Sect keeps both phases active at once: · ‖color:gui.orange‖Aspected Benefic‖end‖: when you apply treatment to an ally, they gain an additional ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% maximum health until the end of the round. · ‖color:gui.orange‖Helios Conjunction‖end‖: crew within ‖color:gui.green‖600‖end‖ units gain a permanent aura of ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% maximum health and ‖color:gui.green‖5‖end‖% movement speed. The two stack with each other.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_wheeloffortune: The Wheel surrounds you: you take ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% less damage.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_ascend: Someone has fallen: the rescuer's hands work twice as fast.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_gravity: You gain ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% ‖color:gui.orange‖stun resistance‖end‖ — harder to knock down or stagger.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_primary_gravit: Gravity holds you steady: ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% stun resistance.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_exaltation: The stars walk beside you: you take ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% less damage.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_astral: Your ‖color:gui.orange‖skill gain speed‖end‖ is increased by ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖%, and your ‖color:gui.orange‖medical skill‖end‖ by ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖.\nEach ally you treat adds ‖color:gui.green‖1‖end‖ stack of Astral; each stack adds a further ‖color:gui.green‖5‖end‖%, up to ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖ stacks (‖color:gui.green‖100‖end‖% in total).\nThe talent panel shows your current stacks.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_epicycle: You move at full speed while dragging a character.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_primary_esuna: When you apply a ‖color:gui.orange‖bandage‖end‖ to a crewmate, it also clears their ‖color:gui.orange‖bleeding and burns‖end‖.\nA bandage normally only stops bleeding — this turns it into proper first aid.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_draw_star: The deck of the astral. Hold it and press use to draw: The Balance, The Arrow and The Spire fall into it. Sixty seconds after the draw, the deck and any cards left in it fade away, and the umbral deck takes its place.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_draw_umbral: The deck of the umbral. Hold it and press use to draw: The Spear, The Bole and The Ewer fall into it. Sixty seconds after the draw, the deck and any cards left in it fade away, and the astral deck takes its place.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_balance: A scale with life on one end and death on the other. Drag it onto a crew member in the health interface to raise their melee attack speed by ‖color:gui.green‖30‖end‖% and their ranged attack speed by ‖color:gui.green‖10‖end‖% for 15 seconds.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_arrow: An arrow that never lands. Drag it onto a crew member in the health interface to raise the healing they receive by ‖color:gui.green‖25‖end‖% for 15 seconds.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_spire: A tower that reaches upward. Drag it onto a crew member in the health interface to raise their repair speed and hull repair rate by ‖color:gui.green‖50‖end‖% for 15 seconds.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_spear: A spear thrown never to be retrieved. Drag it onto a crew member in the health interface to raise their melee attack speed by ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% and their ranged attack speed by ‖color:gui.green‖20‖end‖% for 15 seconds.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_bole: The trunk that holds the world up. Drag it onto a crew member in the health interface to reduce the damage they take by ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% for 15 seconds.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_ewer: A pitcher of endless water. Drag it onto a crew member in the health interface so that they need no oxygen and keep healing from their injuries, for 15 seconds.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_synastry: When you treat an ally, your fates briefly intertwine: you slowly recover as well.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_exaltation: While a crewmate is within ‖color:gui.green‖600‖end‖ units, you take ‖color:gui.green‖15‖end‖% less ‖color:gui.orange‖damage‖end‖.\nThe stars only shine for those who walk together — the protection fades when you are alone.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_synastry: Your fate is intertwined with another's; your wounds are slowly ebbing away.
infotexts.talentdescription.mcj_arcanum_minor: Every draw yields one extra minor arcana.\nAstral Draw grants the ‖color:gui.orange‖Lord of Crowns‖end‖, Umbral Draw the ‖color:gui.orange‖Lady of Crowns‖end‖.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_lord: The burning face of the crown. It is simply a frag grenade — pull the pin, throw it, and wait for the fuse.
infotexts.entitydescription.mcj_card_lady: The merciful face of the crown. A fix-foam grenade — pull the pin, throw it, and it seals the hull all around where it lands.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_drew_star: The Astral Draw is in effect.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_drew_umbral: The Umbral Draw is in effect.
infotexts.afflictiondescription.mcj_deck_used: Hidden marker: this deck has already been drawn from. Wait for it to flip to the other pole.
